definitions.before: freshly initialized model representation on the validation target
definitions.reliability_filtered: best-model target representation with reliability >= configured threshold
definitions.threshold_zero: baseline architecture with an independent checkpoint and reliability threshold set to 0
definitions.target_accuracy: classifier accuracy on validation target, retained as an offline diagnostic only
definitions.pseudo_accuracy: source-prototype pseudo-label accuracy on selected validation samples
definitions.rgpa_pca: fresh and trained spaces are source-paired orthogonally aligned; PCA is fitted on trained-source shared embeddings and target is transform-only
definitions.comparison_error_bars: standard deviation across held-out subjects, not across repeated training runs
